messages:
jason (support): FYI customer "AcmeTravel" escalated — their rerank calls started returning 504s and some 502s under a synthetic load test this morning. p95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~2.3s and errors followed.

jason (support): repro steps they ran: simple loop of batched rerank requests (~200 QPS) with batch_size=64, payload = arrays of 64 strings. They saw timeouts after ~6 minutes.

jason (support): sample curl they ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \ 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
 -d '{"model":"rerank-small","queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[["c1","c2",...]]}'
```

jason (support): error snippet customer got in prod logs:
```
ERROR gateway: upstream timeout (504) request_id=abc123 route=/v1/rerank host=gateway-1
WARN proxy: retrying request, retries=3
ERROR backend: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = kvcache OOM
```

sahil (eng-ranker): thanks — couple of things to check: large batch_size + high QPS can cause memory pressure on the ranker worker (kv cache + per-request tensors). Any error rates on Dedicated pods or OOMs?

jason (support): customer is on Hosted; no dedicated contract. They said no quota throttles reported. I asked them to share full request_id but they sent sample request_id abc123.

lee (eng-platform): pulling traces for request_id=abc123 now. Seeing long tail on ranking step: backend.rerank.compute p95 ~2.1s for those traces, and gateway logged many 502/504 around same time window. Also see high retry storms from client (they didn't backoff).

olivia (sre): any recent config changes for routing, autoscale, or kernel swaps? Deploybot, did we have any rolling infra around 08:15 UTC?

deploybot: deploy/gateway-service v2.14.1 -> v2.14.2 at 08:05 UTC. No notable failed pods.

sahil (eng-ranker): possible hypotheses: 1) large batches trigger fallback to non-optimized attention kernel causing CPU spike, 2) kv-cache growth + GC pause, 3) client retry behavior creating thundering herd.

sahil (eng-ranker): quick repro we can run in staging: run synthetic generator at 150 QPS with batch_size=64 for 10 minutes against rerank-staging, capture pod metrics (GPU mem, CPU, net), and ranker logs. Can someone start this?

lee (eng-platform): I can spin up a controlled load test. Which model variant did they use?

jason (support): model reported = "rerank-v1-small-quant". They were using 8 concurrent runners from their side, with no jitter.

olivia (sre): schedule: I'll open an incident-1 and reserve a staging namespace. lee, please run the test and attach metric dashboards (pod-level). sahil, can you add extra debug logging to ranker for KV cache sizes and allocation points? Keep it light — avoid huge logs.

sahil (eng-ranker): will add temporary logs for kv.cache.size and batch.shape and enable a sampling flag. Expecting to push within 30m to staging.

jason (support): asked customer to reduce batch_size to 16 and introduce randomized jitter backoff — they confirmed errors stopped in their quick test.

olivia (sre): interim mitigation for hosted: recommend customers use batch_size<=16 for now and enable client-side exponential backoff; ops will add guidance to support KB.

lee (eng-platform): started load test against rerank-staging at 09:10 UTC: configured 150 QPS, batch_size=64, concurrency=8. Attaching summary when done.

lee (eng-platform): quick findings from staging run: pod GPU memory stable, but CPU of ranker workers spiked and p95 kernel latency jumped. Also saw GC pauses correlate with error windows.

sahil (eng-ranker): that supports kernel fallback + GC hypothesis. Next steps: 1) add soft limit on batch_size at gateway for rerank route, 2) deploy improved kernel selection patch to avoid fallback for this model, 3) instrument kv cache eviction earlier.

jason (support): customer asked for ETA — can we get a short-term change this week? They are seeing production impact.

olivia (sre): short term: enforce gateway batch cap = 32 on rerank route and add request-level rate-leak for aggressive clients. I can push this change tomorrow and monitor.

sahil (eng-ranker): medium term: kernel patch + kv eviction policy — aiming for PR by EOW.

jason (support): noted. I'll update customer: 1) suggest immediate client-side changes (batch_size 16 and jitter), 2) we'll roll gateway cap tomorrow, 3) follow-up on fixes.

lee (eng-platform): created incident ticket INC-2026-224 and attached traces + flamegraphs.

deploybot: rollout/gateway-service batch-cap=32 scheduled at 02:00 UTC tomorrow (canary then full).

sahil (eng-ranker): thanks — will monitor rerank metrics (p95, 5xx rate, kv.cache.hit) and post findings.

jason (support): marking this thread as high-priority customer escalation. Will update with customer repro logs when they reply. :thumbsup:
